_comment_seg: === Segmentation === NOT SET ON PURPOSE. `start: postprocessing` begins AFTER the segmentation step (ParamUtils.STEP_ORDER is preprocessing -> registration -> segmentation -> postprocessing), so masks are read from the segmented checkpoint and no seg_* parameter is consulted. This preset used to carry the full segmentation block including a StarDist model name with no seg_method, which read as a configuration choice and was inert.
_comment_resources: === Resource Limits === NOT SET ON PURPOSE (R4). max_cpus/max_memory have no default and are required by nextflow_schema.json; they are per-SITE, not per-run, so they belong in your own -c site.config (copied from conf/site.config.template), never in a -params-file. A -params-file value overrides -c, so a resource block here would silently defeat any site.config you layer on top of this preset.
